About The Role
 In this role you will own the full stack, crafting React frontends and FastAPI backends for products that power modern energy infrastructure. You’ll shape CI/CD pipelines and Kubernetes-based delivery, collaborating with architects and product teams to build reliable, data-driven applications where your code directly impacts critical energy operations from concept to production.
 Responsibilities
Design and build backend services in Python using FastAPI together with React-based frontend applications to deliver full end-to-end features from concept to production
Own the delivery and quality of implemented features by improving application performance, deployment reliability, and overall user experience across backend and frontend layers
Collaborate closely with architects, QA engineers, and client stakeholders to refine requirements and translate them into working, production-ready solutions
Process, transform, and analyze data using Pandas to support reporting needs and data-driven decision-making within the product
Architect and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps to automate testing, integration, and deployment workflows across multiple environments
Develop and maintain structured Helm Charts to enable standardized, configurable application deployments, including clear versioning and documentation
Containerize services with Docker and orchestrate them using Kubernetes (OpenShift) to enhance deployment consistency, scalability, and operational resilience
Participate in Agile ceremonies to plan, estimate, and deliver work iteratively, ensuring predictable and transparent progress
Review code across backend, frontend, and DevOps areas, sharing best practices and fostering a culture of continuous improvement within the team
Optimize application performance across both React-based frontend and FastAPI backend layers to ensure smooth, responsive, and efficient user experiences
Troubleshoot and resolve issues across the stack, from UI components through backend services to infrastructure and deployment pipelines, keeping releases stable and on schedule
 Requirements
Strong knowledge of backend development with Python, including 5+ years of experience and at least 3+ years working with FastAPI in production environments
Strong proficiency with modern frontend development, including 4+ years of experience building applications with React and related tooling
Practical experience with data processing and analysis in Python, including 1+ year using Pandas or comparable libraries
Advanced experience with designing, implementing, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, with 2+ years working preferably with Azure DevOps
Strong proficiency with containerization and orchestration, including proven experience using Docker and Kubernetes, ideally in OpenShift-based environments
Practical experience with designing RESTful APIs and integrating them with modern frontend applications for end-to-end solutions
Strong problem-solving skills across the full application stack, from user interface through backend services to infrastructure components
Clear communication skills for effective collaboration within cross-functional teams and direct interaction with client stakeholders
Strong proficiency in working with transmission system operators or comparable energy infrastructure companies, understanding domain-specific constraints and workflows
Practical experience with Airflow and/or Splunk for scheduling, monitoring, and observability of distributed systems
Advanced German language skills at C1 level for professional communication in spoken and written form
Practical experience with OpenShift as a Kubernetes distribution (nice-to-have)
